title: Framework PR #27 CI-security Python-quality failure is fixed on the exact PR head, pending resulting-master verification
title_de: Framework-PR #27: CI-Security-Python-Quality-Fehler ist am exakten PR-Head behoben, Verifikation des resultierenden Masters steht aus
summary: Framework PR #27 historically failed CI-security Python quality first on Ruff formatting and then on a deterministic Pyright Mapping.get key-type diagnostic. Repair commit 82a091a3b6c3e5005126966bf3c6900208c8632b accurately types the existing PyYAML Boolean-key fallback as dict[Any, Any] without weakening a control; it is retained in resulting master 6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb, whose tree equals exact head 6a4e057b2cef1f911ba25ab9f95e1b01b390691b. The resulting-master Python-quality control passed, but this record remains fixed, not verified, because the independently failed Advanced CodeQL uploader is recorded in FND-GITHUB-0006.
summary_de: Framework-PR #27 scheiterte historisch im CI-Security-Python-Quality-Job zuerst an Ruff-Formatierung und danach an einer deterministischen Pyright-Mapping.get-Key-Typ-Diagnose. Der Reparatur-Commit 82a091a3b6c3e5005126966bf3c6900208c8632b typisiert den bestehenden PyYAML-Boolean-Key-Fallback ohne Abschwächung eines Controls korrekt als dict[Any, Any]; er ist im resultierenden Master 6de40c1714410241e917e9083ee890a82fb2fdbb enthalten, dessen Tree dem exakten Head 6a4e057b2cef1f911ba25ab9f95e1b01b390691b entspricht. Das Resulting-Master-Python-Quality-Control bestand, aber dieser Record bleibt fixed, nicht verified, weil der unabhängig fehlgeschlagene Advanced-CodeQL-Uploader in FND-GITHUB-0006 erfasst ist.
observed_behavior: At historical exact head 55a46ce68b69c8b6ef758ee94e184688aab995a4, GitHub Actions run 29696794348/job 88218830400 failed while Ruff passed because Pyright emitted check-ci-security-evidence-contract.py:424:42 Argument of type Literal[True] cannot be assigned to parameter key of type str in function get (reportArgumentType). Current exact head 6a4e057b2cef1f911ba25ab9f95e1b01b390691b has terminal passing hosted checks, including python-ci-security-quality.
observed_behavior_de: Am historischen exakten Head 55a46ce68b69c8b6ef758ee94e184688aab995a4 schlug GitHub-Actions-Run 29696794348/Job 88218830400 fehl, während Ruff bestand, weil Pyright check-ci-security-evidence-contract.py:424:42 Argument of type Literal[True] cannot be assigned to parameter key of type str in function get (reportArgumentType) meldete. Der aktuelle exakte Head 6a4e057b2cef1f911ba25ab9f95e1b01b390691b hat terminal erfolgreiche Hosted-Checks, einschließlich python-ci-security-quality.
expected_behavior: The CI-security evidence-contract checker accepts the existing PyYAML Boolean-key compatibility representation while preserving fail-closed event validation. Pyright, Ruff format, and Ruff lint pass at the final PR head and resulting Framework master; no quality or security gate is disabled or weakened.
expected_behavior_de: Der CI-Security-Evidence-Contract-Checker akzeptiert die bestehende PyYAML-Boolean-Key-Kompatibilitätsdarstellung und bewahrt fail-closed Event-Validierung. Pyright, Ruff-Format und Ruff-Lint bestehen am finalen PR-Head und resultierenden Framework-Master; kein Qualitäts- oder Security-Gate wird deaktiviert oder abgeschwächt.
impact: The historical mandatory CI failure is fixed on resulting master and its source-specific Python-quality control passed. The independently failed Advanced CodeQL uploader blocks the broader resulting-master verification; this CI failure alone does not establish an exploitable security-control bypass.
impact_de: Der historische obligatorische CI-Fehler ist auf dem resultierenden Master behoben und sein source-spezifisches Python-Quality-Control bestand. Der unabhängig fehlgeschlagene Advanced-CodeQL-Uploader blockiert die breitere Resulting-Master-Verifikation; dieser CI-Fehler allein belegt keinen ausnutzbaren Security-Control-Bypass.

root_cause: PyYAML may parse unquoted workflow key on as Boolean True. The checker deliberately preserves that fallback with data.get("on", data.get(True)), but its parameter annotation was dict[str, Any], so Pyright correctly rejected the Boolean lookup key.
root_cause_de: PyYAML kann den nicht quotierten Workflow-Key on als Boolean True parsen. Der Checker bewahrt diesen Fallback bewusst mit data.get("on", data.get(True)), aber seine Parameterannotation war dict[str, Any], weshalb Pyright den Boolean-Lookup-Key korrekt ablehnte.
proposed_remediation: Implemented in 82a091a3b6c3e5005126966bf3c6900208c8632b: change only workflow_events(data: dict[str, Any]) to workflow_events(data: dict[Any, Any]). Preserve the existing runtime body and fail-closed PR/trusted CodeQL event controls. Do not suppress Pyright, disable Ruff, cast merely to silence the diagnostic, or weaken the security-evidence contract.
proposed_remediation_de: Implementiert in 82a091a3b6c3e5005126966bf3c6900208c8632b: Nur workflow_events(data: dict[str, Any]) zu workflow_events(data: dict[Any, Any]) ändern. Den bestehenden Runtime-Body und die fail-closed PR-/Trusted-CodeQL-Event-Controls bewahren. Pyright nicht unterdrücken, Ruff nicht deaktivieren, nicht nur zur Unterdrückung der Diagnose casten und den Security-Evidence-Contract nicht abschwächen.
